entities.name: Indorama Sustainable Polyester Yarns Private Limited

industry: Consumer Discretionary > Textiles > Textiles & Apparels > Other Textile Products

operating_notes.text: FY26 exceptional item of ₹2.70 Cr relates to the incremental impact of the New Labour Codes, presented as non-recurring.
The group operates in one reportable segment: manufacturing and trading of polyester goods.
FY26 other expenses rose 16.4% to ₹705.95 Cr, faster than revenue's 15.3%.
Approved an expansion plan of approx. ₹200 Cr for speciality filament and fibre production at the Butibori plant.
H1 FY27 total income stood at ₹2,284.2 crore, registering a degrowth of 9.7% due to supply chain issues from Middle East geopolitical developments.
Q2FY27 EBITDA margin 8.8% vs 11.5% in Q1FY27, a 270 bps sequential dip despite 43% QoQ revenue growth.
Polyester production capacity of 6.72 lakh TPA, including 2.52 lakh TPA PET resin and 1.75 lakh TPA DTY, with 71.08 MW captive power.
Products reach customers across 19 states/UTs in India and 28 countries globally.

timeline.summary: On 23 April 2026 Indo Rama disclosed postal ballot results: members passed; the appointments of Vipin Kumar as Non-Executive Non-Independent Director and Sanjay Gupta as Whole-time Director.
Om Prakash Lohia (Promoter) declared no encumbrance on Indo Rama Synthetics’ shares for FY2025-26 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) on 2026-04-06.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,201.66 Cr, net profit ₹64.13 Cr (+25.6% YoY).
On May 25, 2026, Indo Rama Synthetics appointed Deloitte Haskins & Sells LLP as internal auditors for FY27 and passed routine board resolutions.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,340.64 Cr (+9.8% YoY), net profit ₹74.08 Cr (+201.8% YoY).
On October 16, 2026, Indo Rama Synthetics approved a ~₹200 Cr expansion plan for speciality filament and fibre production at its Butibori plant.
On October 16, 2026, Indo Rama Synthetics reported Q2FY27 total income of ₹1,344 Cr and PAT of ₹74.1 Cr, alongside a ₹200 Cr specialty fibre capex plan.
Q2FY27 press release (consolidated): total income ₹1,344.0 Cr (+10.0% YoY), EBITDA ₹117.7 Cr (+46.4%), PAT ₹74.1 Cr (+201.8%); H1FY27 total income ₹2,284.2 Cr (-9.7% YoY).
Indo Rama Synthetics reported Q2FY27 total income of ₹1,344.0 Cr and PAT of ₹74.1 Cr in its investor presentation.
